title: Onboard context-aware Llama-Ultra variant, define pin playbook, and publish perf profiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket covers the technical onboarding of the recently ingested model variant 'llama-ultra-13B-context' into the model catalog, the creation of an operational pinning/playbook suitable for runtime rollouts, and the generation + publication of a complete performance profile bundle. Work focuses on: 1) producing reproducible perf signatures across sequence-length slices and caching states, 2) defining a deterministic pin rule and fallback chain for quantized variants, 3) updating catalog docs and Console model entry to surface recommended batch sizes, KV cache compatibility, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Performance profile published to catalog with measured throughput/latency/cost across short/medium/long contexts
Pin playbook documented (canary percentages, rollback criteria, telemetry gates) and approved by Product and SRE
Console model page updated with new fields: suggested_batching, supported_sequence_lengths, soft_kv_compatibility, quantization_recommendation
Automated perf test added to perf-harness that validates P50/P90/P99 against baseline on dedicated test GPU and runs in CI
No high-severity regressions on canary (metrics: tail latency, error rate, token cost) and rollouts successfully complete to 100%
Tech writer review and PR merged for public docs with examples for text-generation and chat SDK snippets
tasks: Run synthetic benchmarks (short=32, medium=512, long=2048) with cold and warmed KV cache and capture P50/P90/P99 and memory peaks
Generate perf signature file (perf-signature-v1) including kernel-path hints and env matrix used for measurements
Define pin policy: primary pin to llama-ultra-13B-context:v1, fallback chain => llama-ultra-13B-quant8/v1 then llama-ultra-7B-quant8/v2
Add catalog schema fields for soft_kv_compatibility (yes/no), recommended_quantization (none|q8|q4), and suggested_batching (numbers)
Create canary rollout plan with 5% -> 25% -> 100% steps and explicit telemetry gates and cooldown windows
Update Console model entry UI copy and add latency/cost micrographs for quick decision making
Author perf-harness CI job and integrate into nightly runs and PR checks
Open GitHub PRs for catalog metadata (catalog repo) and Console docs (web repo) and link them here
Coordinate a short experimental run with Solutions Eng on a customer workload to sanity-check generation quality under pinned configuration

2025-03-11 - Alex (Product): Reviewed canary plan, requested explicit rollback thresholds: P99 latency +30% OR error_rate > 0.5% triggers rollback. Added to playbook.

notes: Key risk is quality regression when using quantized fallback for cost-sensitive tiers. Plan includes an A/B QA pass using customer-like prompts and the eval-suite to detect semantic drift before any wide rollout. Will also coordinate with Research to capture a small reference eval set (50 prompts) for nightly regression detection.
